estimate.constraint_note: IFRS 15.50–58 variable consideration (IFRIC Sept 2019): EU261 compensation is a reduction of passenger revenue, estimated on € claim curves (expected ultimate claim rate, history to M18 + tail judgment) and constrained under IFRS 15.56; held / needs-Legal items accrue at their segment rate until resolved. €13,968.40 of the estimate is on entitlement held pending Legal, accrued at segment rates under the IFRS 15.56 constraint. Presented in full within passenger revenue (IAG approach); IFRIC left open whether the reduction is capped at nil; refunded passengers have a nil transaction price.
